observations.explanation: The tissue-context predicate cannot have a payload as its subject. The LNP formulation is the appropriate intervention/formulation subject and is co-supported with the liver context in the same clause.

evidence.quote: A cross-species, LNP-formulated siRNA targeting PCSK9 induced potent (50% to 70%) and durable silencing of hepatic mRNA in rodents and nonhuman primates.

observations.explanation: The outcome clause refers only anaphorically to the preceding intervention. It does not explicitly co-support the PCSK9-targeting siRNA payload entity and plasma PCSK9 protein endpoint in one exact source quote.

evidence.quote: This resulted in a sustained reduction in plasma PCSK9 protein and a corresponding >60% decrease in LDL cholesterol that lasted several weeks after a single dosage, without affecting HDL-C or TGs.
